q1_issues.issue: The office NP is fused into the compound symbol caretaker_of_breakheart_hill with an invented genus link, a shape the instruction set does not license — compound kinds are modifier+head-noun, while a genuinely possessive of-phrase maps to Possession/PartOf.

The proper noun "Breakheart Hill" is swallowed into that compound and receives no symbol and no (Name ...) fact, and the fused symbol itself carries no Name atom either, so a proper noun in the text ends up unrepresented.

The past-tense capacity adjunct is converted into an untensed top-level (Member henry_cole caretaker_of_breakheart_hill), asserting as a standing present fact an office the sentence says Bailey took over.
Nothing links the "as Caretaker of Breakheart Hill" phrase to the following event — the adjunct is dropped from the event's role/oblique structure entirely.

q2_gaps: capacity / predicative "as NP" adjunct on a verb ("was followed as Caretaker of X", "served as chairman") — no role, oblique or operator is defined for it

an office / position NP headed by a common noun with an of-phrase naming a place ("Caretaker of Breakheart Hill"), where the capitalized run also triggers the multi-word-name rule and the two readings conflict
notes: The passive is handled correctly — the by-phrase takes Agent and the surface subject Theme, with Past on the event and both person Names emitted.
